## Load Packages

Load necessary R packages for data manipulation, visualization, and GO analysis.

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| message: false
#| warning: false

pacman::p_load(ComplexUpset, install = FALSE)

conflicted::conflict_prefer_all("dplyr", quiet = TRUE)

source(here("custom_func/go_term_weights.R"))
```

## Set the top number of genes

```{r}
#| label: set-top-number
#| message: false

# top_n <- 1000
```

## Load Results

Read the previously saved GO enrichment results for top 500 CpG sites.

```{r}
#| label: load-results
#| message: false

all_results <- read_rds(here(glue("pathway_analysis/02_gene_ontology/output/top{params$top_n}_all_GO_results.rds"))) |>
  mutate(condition = factor(
    condition, 
    levels = c("normal2mci", "stable_mci", "normal2incid", "mci2incid", "prev")
  ))

glimpse(all_results)
```

## Drop duplicate parent terms (Rule 1)

A significant parent term whose genes in the background set are identical to those of a significant child term has the same test in every group; it is dropped and the child kept (reviewer round, 2026-10-09). The map comes from `06_go_hierarchy/03_go_term_weights.qmd`, which runs right after the enrichment.

```{r}
#| label: drop-duplicate-parents

duplicate_parents <- read_go_duplicate_parents(params$top_n)

all_results <- all_results |>
  filter(!ID %in% duplicate_parents$parent)

glue("Dropped {nrow(duplicate_parents)} duplicate parent terms")
```

## Upset Plot function

```{r}


create_upset_plot <- function(data, y_limit = 200, min_size = 0) {
  upset(
    data = data,
    intersect = c("normal2mci", "stable_mci", "normal2incid", "mci2incid", "prev"),
    name = "Dementia Transitions", 
    width_ratio = 0.2,
    min_size = min_size,
    wrap = TRUE,
    encode_sets = FALSE,
    matrix = intersection_matrix( geom = geom_point(size = 1)),
    set_sizes = (
      upset_set_size() +
      geom_text( aes(label = after_stat(count) |> format(big.mark = ",")), hjust = 1.1, stat = 'count', size = 6 / .pt) +
      expand_limits(y = y_limit) +
        # scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.2)) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30))
    ),
    base_annotations=list(
        'Intersection size'=intersection_size(
            text_colors=c(on_background='black', on_bar='white'),
            text = list(size = 6 / .pt, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = -0.3)
        ) +
        labs(y = "Intersection")),
    themes=upset_default_themes(panel.grid=element_blank(), axis.text=element_text(size=6), axis.title=element_text(size=8))
  )
}
```

## Create UpSet Plot

```{r}
#| label: upset-plot
#| fig.width: 12
#| fig.height: 10
go_wide <- all_results |>
  # Filter for significant terms
  filter(p.adjust <= 0.05) |>
  # Select relevant columns and remove duplicates
  select(ID, condition) |>
  distinct() |>
  # Prepare data for upset plot
  mutate(presence = 1) |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = ID,
    names_from = condition,
    values_from = presence,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# Set-size labels are drawn past the end of the bar (hjust = 1.1), so the axis must
# clear the largest set or the longest bar's label is cut off at the panel edge.
max_set <- go_wide |> select(-ID) |> colSums() |> max()

upset_plot <- go_wide |>
  create_upset_plot(
    y_limit = max(300, ceiling(max_set * 1.15 / 50) * 50),
    min_size = 5
  )

upset_plot
```


## Identify Condition-Specific Terms

```{r}
specific_terms <- all_results |>
  filter(p.adjust <= 0.05) |>
  add_count(ID, name = "n_GO") |>
  filter(n_GO == 1) |>
  select(-n_GO)

glimpse(specific_terms)
```

## Count the number of specific terms in each condition.

The set must equal the terms weighted in `06_go_hierarchy/03_go_term_weights.qmd`.

```{r}
stopifnot(
  setequal(
    str_c(specific_terms$condition, specific_terms$ID),
    with(read_go_term_weights(params$top_n), str_c(condition, ID))
  )
)

specific_terms |>
  count(condition)
```

## Save the results

```{r}
fs::dir_create(here("pathway_analysis/03_transition_specific_GO_terms/output"))

specific_terms |>
  select(ID, Description, condition) |>
  write_csv(here(glue("pathway_analysis/03_transition_specific_GO_terms/output/top{params$top_n}_condition_specific_GO_terms.csv")))
```

## Save the upset plot

```{r}
write_rds(
  upset_plot,
  here(glue("pathway_analysis/03_transition_specific_GO_terms/output/top{params$top_n}_condition_specific_GO_terms.rds"))
)
```
